processing.source: Earth Search STAC, sentinel-2-c1-l2a (ESA Collection 1, L2A surface reflectance)
processing.reflectance: DN * scale + offset from STAC raster:bands (Collection 1: 0.0001, -0.1)
processing.pixel_rule: 20 m pixel centre inside the monitoring cell

reasons: Forest pixels match the baseline within the change thresholds.

isolation_forest.model: IsolationForest(n_estimators=200, contamination=0.05, random_state=7) trained on earlier years, scikit-learn 1.9.1

limitations: Satellite change detection is evidence for review, not proof of carbon loss.
Harvest permitted by a project's rules, storms, insects, drought and phenology can all look like change.
A 1 km monitoring cell samples a project; it does not measure the whole project or its carbon stock.
Clouds, smoke and haze are masked imperfectly; persistence over two clear looks reduces, not removes, false alarms.
The method says nothing about additionality, baselines or leakage, the main reasons credits have been overstated.
